content: Intern at [Shanghai AI Lab](https://www.shlab.org.cn/). Working on Mixture-of-Experts explorations, including Dense-to-Sparse strategies and Supervised Fine-Tuning on MoE models. Mentors are [Xiaoye Qu](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=rT3hqdcAAAAJ) and [Yu Cheng](https://ych133.github.io/).
